snippet.title: Pulsebreaker - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Pulsebreaker is an upcoming survival horror game inspired by classic survival horror PS1-era titles. You step into the boots of Soren Eckhart, a lone survivor navigating through a deadly and mysterious outbreak. Scavenge scarce supplies, solve environmental puzzles, and fight to survive against grotesque mutated foes while uncovering the truth behind why the city has become infected.

Wishlist and play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851600/Pulsebreaker/ 
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
